classification: SYNTHETIC SCENARIO — MODERATOR ANSWER KEY, NOT USER RESEARCH
source_recommendation: Ask the hosting contact to check renewal, the certificate names and full trusted chain. Install the correct certificate, then run an authorized scan again.

grading.correct_issue: Identify HTTPS/TLS certificate renewal/expiry maintenance for merchant.example, which is Top 1 at the fixed scenario observation time. Accept plain equivalent language; do not require the rule ID or exact day count. Record confusion about dates separately; never infer compromise from this example.
grading.sensible_next_action: Accept asking the hosting/IT contact to check or renew/install the HTTPS certificate. One sensible next step is sufficient; do not require every technical detail or exact wording. An authorized recheck is recommended. Mark task done alone, SPF/DMARC alone, or a claim that the site is safe is not sufficient.
grading.grading_method: Moderator records answer before grading; team checks rubric. No automated/LLM grading. No clues before the timed answer.
